_comment: Game/system parameters. sloop_grades and power values are PLACEHOLDER example values pending in-game confirmation (see Design.md §8).

augmenters._note: Each Alien Power Augmenter costs `cost` Somersloops and adds `bonus` * base (unaugmented) generation, additively (not compounding).

sloop_grades._note: Per-grade multipliers on a machine running with k Somersloops: rho = output, kappa = input consumption, pi = power draw. DEFAULT IS A PLACEHOLDER — CONFIRM per Design.md §8. Chosen so sloops are strictly valuable: rho=kappa=2^k (output and input both double, conserving material balance) but pi=1 (slooped machines draw the same power). NOTE: if pi were also 2^k, a slooped machine is exactly equivalent to 2^k extra buildings and Somersloops would only matter via per-recipe machine caps.

machines._note: power_draw = MW consumed at 100% clock (generators draw 0). max_sloops caps the sloop grades available to this building.
